# grpc-health-kit

> The gRPC health checking protocol for Python without protoc or protobuf: a status registry, Check and Watch semantics, a hand-written wire codec and a grpcio handler adapter Python package `trysac-grpc-health-kit`, import name `grpc_health_kit`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
